text_block_list.text:
The day of the Make Debut had finally arrived.
An ordinary Umamusume would be full of nerves right now, but—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hey, that room fragrance...
Did you put that there?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The main aroma is jasmine.
Perhaps chosen to help ease tension?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the concern.

Worrying about easing her nerves might be unnecessary moving forward.
This mental fortitude is, as expected...
choice_data_list: (Her background probably has something to do with it, too.)

text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna's family is a meritocracy...
It's easy to deduce she has been exposed
to stressful situations ever since she was a child.
choice_data_list: By the way, what about your family...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Is something wrong with your family?
choice_data_list: So you're not coming to watch the race?
Aren't you coming to watch the race?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The only thing all of you care about... is the result.
In other words, whether I emerged as the victor or not.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I, too, feel guilty about taking up so much
of everyone's valuable time for a mere Debut race.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Besides... going forward, everyone will learn
just how strong I am, whether they like it or not.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Even without an invitation, the day will come when they seek it out themselves.
—Without fail.

Gentildonna's lips curled into a smirk.
Wondering what she would do next...
I shivered a little from excitement.
"—Her overflowing confidence was keenly felt even by the sensitive Umamusume before the race."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Eek!
Gentildonna-san...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna...
Gentildonna...

Gentildonna strides majestically ahead,
completely unfazed by the rustling whispers around her.

With every step she takes,
a path opens up before her—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Now, shall we begin?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: A path to becoming the "mightiest of all."
